taskDescription: Complete the crossword using key terms from PA H8 | Lymphadenopathy & Lymphomas.

words.clue: Enlargement of lymph nodes beyond normal limits, defined in adults as >1 cm in any axis.
Type of lymphadenopathy where nodes retain normal architecture while responding to an infection stimulus.
Primary malignancy of lymphoid tissue that can present with nodal or extranodal involvement.
Hyperplasia pattern affecting cortical B-cell zones with enlarged secondary follicles and prominent germinal centres.
Hyperplasia pattern in the T-cell zone, commonly seen in EBV infection and viral diseases.
Disease characterized by non-caseating granulomas causing bilateral hilar and cervical lymphadenopathy.
Infection producing matted lymph nodes with caseation and a characteristic collar-stud appearance.
Descriptor for lymph node enlargement from carcinoma spread originating in breast, lung, or thyroid.
Non-caseating inflammatory lesions that characterize the pathology of sarcoidosis.
Type of lymph node considered abnormal when its size exceeds 0.5 cm.
Large cells with pale nuclei and prominent nucleoli seen during T-cell stimulation in hyperplasia.
